string-array.name: items_bpr_mild
string-array.item: Conduct early symptom detection.
Remove infected pods immediately and destroy them.
Improve drainage around affected trees.
Prune lightly to increase airflow and reduce humidity.

resources.string: Continue weekly scouting, especially during wet weather.

string-array.name: items_bpr_mod
string-array.item: Intensify pod removal and sanitation.
Prune dense canopy and diseased branches.
Apply approved fungicides as per local guidelines.
Improve water management and avoid waterlogging.

resources.string: Combine sanitation, pruning, and fungicide as an integrated strategy.
Reduce epidemic pressure and protect remaining yield.

string-array.name: items_bpr_sev
string-array.item: Remove infected and mummified pods farm-wide.
Substantial pruning to open canopy and reduce humidity.
Implement an intensive fungicide program.
Strengthen drainage and consider replanting with tolerant material.

resources.string: Use a coordinated, plantation-wide integrated disease management program.
Prevent spread and protect marketable pods.

string-array.name: items_cpb_mild
string-array.item: Harvest ripe pods every 7–10 days to break pest life cycle.
Remove and destroy visibly infested pods.
Prune lightly to improve airflow and visibility.
Keep the farm floor clean of husks and debris.

resources.string: Continue sanitation and weekly monitoring. Chemical control is usually unnecessary.
Reduce population and prevent economic losses.

string-array.name: items_cpb_mod
string-array.item: Increase harvest frequency to every 5–7 days.
Prune dense canopies and remove chupons.
Bag young pods to reduce egg laying.
Apply approved insecticides or biological control agents.

resources.string: Combine sanitation, pruning, and targeted control. Monitor every 1–2 weeks.
Rapidly suppress the outbreak and restore production.

string-array.name: items_cpb_sev
string-array.item: Aggressive harvesting and destruction of infested pods.
Reduce canopy density through substantial pruning.
Farm-wide pest control operation following local advice.
Coordinate control efforts with neighboring farms.

AtiCao is an AI-powered tool designed to help cacao farmers identify common pests and diseases in cacao pods.

Developed by: FiveNightsAtAjIsland
